cops.line: Alfred Bello had a partner and he had a rap for the cops
stanza: Alfred Bello had a partner and he had a rap for the cops
Him and Arthur Dexter Bradley were just out prowling around
He said, “I saw two men running out, they looked like middleweights
They jumped into a white car with out-of-state plates”

cops.line: The old man at the Quick Stop, lying to the county cops
stanza: Jamie found a boyfriend with smiling eyes and dark skin
And her daddy never spoke another word to her again
The old man at the Quick Stop, lying to the county cops
And laughing like his soul was without sin

cops.line: And I'll never see them again if I squeal to the cops
stanza: I keep the wolf from the door, but he calls me up
Calls me on the phone, tells me all the ways that he's gonna mess me up
Steal all my children if I don't pay the ransom
And I'll never see them again if I squeal to the cops

cops.line: Then we slept in the back of my truck and got woken up by the cops
stanza: I remember you a few days later in Tofino
Where we'd driven to play a show you'd set up for us at a surf shop to no one
Then we slept in the back of my truck and got woken up by the cops
And so went down to the fishing boat docks to ask whoever for a ride
Across the water to Meares Island to just get left there for the day
And we did, and brought some food to eat and went through the big trees
Abandoned and in love, totally insane, apart from the rest of the world
We had finally found each other in the universe

cops.line: With you riding shotgun, speeding 'cause fuck the cops
stanza: I wanna live at the Holiday Inn
Where somebody else makes the bed
We'll watch TV while the lights on the street
Put all the stars to death
It's been on my mind since Bowie died
Just checkin' out to hide from life
And all of our problems, I'm gonna solve 'em
With you riding shotgun, speeding 'cause fuck the cops

cops.line: Latches and locks, companies of cops

stanza: See them cops?
They believe everything they read in the papers about us cruddy JDs
So that's what we give 'em
Somethin' to believe in

stops.line: You hit the ground and then it stops
stanza: My eighteenth birthday, I'll die of boredom
Girl singing in the wreckage
My private world is smashed wide open
Girl singing in the wreckage
My first trip, my expectation
I had a dream that it would end like this
No destiny, no destination
You hit the ground and then it stops

stops.line: What do you do when the drowning stops?
stanza: Stay here for a little while more
'Cause it's a funny thing
Yes, it's a funny thing
I need a friend, not an angel
What do you do when the drowning stops?

stops.line: Ooh, after all the folderol and hauling over coals stops
stanza: Ooh, after all the folderol and hauling over coals stops
What will I do?

stops.line: I am my mother's child, I'll love you 'til my breathing stops
stanza: I am my mother's child, I'll love you 'til my breathing stops
I'll love you 'til you call the cops on me
But in our darkest hours, I stumbled on a secret power
I'll find a way to be without you, babe

shops.line: I hate graveyards and old pawn shops
stanza: I hate graveyards and old pawn shops
For they always bring me tears
I can't forgive the way they rob me
Of my childhood souvenirs
